supersedes.why: That pass was not reproducible. The suite identified its subject caller by object_receipt_id alone, and an applied review leaves ten callers on one receipt: the ordinary_put writer it closes, plus the ordinary_recovery_read and one ordinary_retirement_inventory per page, which 0082/0093 REQUIRE to stay returned. An unordered select therefore returned whichever row the planner offered -- the writer first under an index scan on media_storage_calls_receipt_idx (pass), last in heap order (fail). The 2026-11-15 qualification was obtained on a favourable plan and measured roughly 50% failure thereafter.
supersedes.fixedBy: The helper now names the writer by kind, asserts it is the only one, and asserts the other nine are exactly ordinary_recovery_read/ordinary_retirement_inventory and all returned -- so a stopped read caller, which the triggers forbid, would now fail the suite. Tests only; no runtime change.
